messages:
aya: Heads up 1: were getting mTLS handshake_failures and customer 502s in ap-northeast after the cert-rotator run at 00:40 UTC. Anyone oncall?

ben: Seeing spike in handshake latency ~900ms then TLS alert 40 from proxies. Traces: trc-apn-0400-1c2d.

tarun: rotator logs show a burst of kms:Decrypt calls and a few KMS rate_limit_exceeded between 00:39:58-00:40:22. cert-rotator-bot: summary?

cert-rotator-bot: rotator v5 executed: batch=ap-northeast, concurrency=5, rotated intermediate=interm-2026-04-10, start=00:39:45, end=00:41:10, kms_errors=4, retries=2.

aya: Could be KMS unwrap latency -> control-plane couldn't staple OCSP or assemble keys in time and proxies saw incomplete handshakes.

ben: Quick check with openssl against proxy-apn-02:443 shows chain present but "OCSP response: no response sent".

aya: Remediation: 1) pause rotator for ap-northeast and rerun with concurrency=1, 2) hotfix proxy handshake timeout to 8s, 3) open support case with KMS, 4) add unwrap-success preflight to rotator.

tarun: I'll pause the rotator now and re-run low concurrency. pausing... done. Re-run scheduled.

deploy-bot: proxy hotfix PR created: https://git.internal/r/proxy/pulls/3201 (handshake timeout -> 8s).

ben: For follow-up: add alert if OCSP staple missing rate >0.5% within 20m of rotation, require 10m canary for any rotator change that alters concurrency, and log KMS throttle events into incident timeline.

aya: Also add RBAC checklist item: avoid simultaneous IAM changes + rotations. Postmortem items assigned. Marking incident P1 until no more 502s. :eyes:
